title: Jose Alves feat. Yonaiker Alexander - Apologia (Original Mix)

lines.l: This is an Apology of the Azul
We'll be right back.
Sigo vivo por milagro
Por encima de todas las cosas
Amo la vida
Quisiera llegar
El último
El último viaje
Como quien sigue en un mostrador
Y despide al dueño del bar
Si lo va a trabol
O logra ser feliz con poco
Y liviano de equipaje
Porque la felicidad está dentro tuyo
Con olor a nada
This is not an apology to the poverty, this is an apology to the human being.
But as we have invented a consumer society
And the economy has to grow, because if you don't grow, it's a tragedy
Inventamos a mountain of superfluous consumption
and you have to take a disc and buy and buy and buy and buy and buy.
And what we are spending is time of life.
Because when I buy something,
or you,
you don't buy something with money,
you buy something with the time of life that you have to spend
to have that money.
But with this difference,
the only thing that you can buy is the life
